summary.free_volume_definition: union of sampled sensor rays at 0.5m voxel resolution, 1Hz/1024 endpoints/12m range; observation proxy, not ground truth

command_audit.scope: Exact recorded neural map at each command audit timestamp, recorded reaction plus bounded-braking body-yaw sweep (legacy records use their constant 1s sweep), 0.5 threshold, physical footprint, context and 1-second TTL. Confirms command gate; does not establish learned model ground-truth accuracy.

published_command_match.scope: Equal linear/angular values within 1e-7, nearby bag receipt within 100ms; odometry-header lag is recorded separately, not used to reject velocity associations. Every matched accepted candidate has been checked independently against its exact HT map by COMMAND_AUDIT.json. Receipt proximity does not uniquely identify a publish when identical velocities repeat.

mesh_contact.scope: Static box contacts at recorded full CMU poses, same dimensions as CMU visual chassis and exact original meshes. Samples at >=1cm or >=1degree changes or 1second; not a guarantee between sampled poses. No wheel contact dynamics, no motor integration, and no real-vehicle validation. Used as independent evaluation, never fed into navigation.
